SELECT 'cal' AS k, fiscal_year AS a, CAST(fiscal_quarter AS VARCHAR) AS b, CAST(MIN(calendar_date) AS VARCHAR) AS c, CAST(MAX(calendar_date) AS VARCHAR) AS d, CAST(COUNT(*) AS VARCHAR) AS e, CAST(MIN(fiscal_period) AS VARCHAR) || '-' || CAST(MAX(fiscal_period) AS VARCHAR) AS f
FROM dim_date WHERE fiscal_year='FY2024/25' AND fiscal_quarter=4 GROUP BY 1,2,3

FROM dim_store WHERE is_current GROUP BY region, format

SELECT 'sales' AS t, COUNT(*) AS n_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS n_keys, COUNT(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) AS n_receipt_lines, MIN(sale_date) AS mn, MAX(sale_date) AS mx, MAX(etl_loaded_at) AS loaded
FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-27' AND DATE '2025-04-27'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'returns', COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT return_line_id), COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id), MIN(return_date), MAX(return_date), NULL
FROM fact_return_line WHERE return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-27' AND DATE '2025-04-27'

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, p.sku,
           f.net_amount AS net_sales, f.standard_cost AS cost
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, p.sku, -r.refund_net, -r.standard_cost_returned
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT cp.sku, cp.product_name, cp.category, cp.subcategory, cp.brand,
       SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales, SUM(n.net_sales - n.cost) AS gross_margin,
       ROUND(100.0*SUM(n.net_sales - n.cost)/SUM(n.net_sales),1) AS gm_pct
FROM net_lines n
JOIN dim_date d     ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
JOIN dim_store cs   ON cs.store_id = n.store_id AND cs.is_current
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = n.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_quarter = 4
  AND cs.region = 'South'
GROUP BY 1,2,3,4,5
ORDER BY gross_margin DESC
LIMIT 14

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, p.sku, f.net_amount AS net_sales, f.standard_cost AS cost
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, p.sku, -r.refund_net, -r.standard_cost_returned
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
mine AS (
    SELECT n.store_id, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales
    FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = n.store_id AND cs.is_current
    WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_quarter=4 AND cs.region='South'
    GROUP BY 1
),
ctl AS (
    SELECT store_id, SUM(net_sales) AS ctl_net FROM rpt_daily_store_sales
    WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-27' AND DATE '2025-04-27' GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT m.store_id, m.net_sales, c.ctl_net, ROUND(m.net_sales - c.ctl_net,2) AS gap
FROM mine m LEFT JOIN ctl c USING (store_id)
UNION ALL
SELECT NULL, SUM(m.net_sales), SUM(c.ctl_net), ROUND(SUM(m.net_sales)-SUM(c.ctl_net),2) FROM mine m LEFT JOIN ctl c USING (store_id)
ORDER BY 1

SELECT p.sku,
       COUNT(*) AS lines,
       SUM(CASE WHEN f.standard_cost IS NULL OR f.standard_cost = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS zero_cost_lines,
       SUM(CASE WHEN ABS(f.standard_cost - f.quantity * p.standard_unit_cost) > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cost_mismatch,
       COUNT(DISTINCT p.product_key) AS versions_used,
       MIN(f.quantity) AS min_q, MAX(f.quantity) AS max_q,
       SUM(CASE WHEN f.net_amount <= 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nonpos_net
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id=s.store_id AND cs.is_current
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-27' AND DATE '2025-04-27' AND cs.region='South'
  AND p.sku IN (103075,100955,101763,103390,100953,103062,102468,102538,101398,101888,102116)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
